what_to_detect: A spell candidate cast through its emerge cost (sacrificing a creature) is affordable because its total cost is reduced by the sacrificed creature's mana value.
near_miss: An emerge-cost candidate that is not affordable: the reduction the sacrificed creature gives leaves more mana than its controller can pay.
record_fields: candidates[].ability (the Emerge keyword line: script_api_type Keyword, keyword_display_name Emerge)

what_to_detect: A spell candidate cast through an 'emerge from [quality]' cost is affordable because its total cost is reduced by the mana value of the sacrificed permanent of that quality.
near_miss: An emerge-from candidate that is not affordable: no permanent of the quality can be sacrificed, or its mana value leaves too much to pay.
record_fields: candidates[].ability (the Emerge keyword line: script_api_type Keyword, keyword_display_name Emerge)
